question: During WWII, Allied intelligence estimated Germany was producing about 1,400 tanks a month. Postwar German records revealed the true figure. About how many tanks a month was Germany really building?
anchorText: showed the actual number to be 245

question: A hagfish can produce so much slime it risks clogging its own gills. How does it clear the slime off its body?
choices: It thrashes and shakes the slime off
It secretes an enzyme that dissolves the slime
It ties itself in a knot and slides it off
It scrapes against rocks on the seafloor
anchorText: they can tie themselves in an overhand knot
